value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Root cause proven with pm-changelog 2026.11.13: core.autocrlf=true yields 536 CRLF lines and changelog:check fails tracker_changed with the same 873-line diff truncation. Full generated output equals all committed bytes after CRLF normalization; all 11 Closed blocks are present and unchanged. UTC, America/Los_Angeles and Pacific/Kiritimati pass on LF. Installed generator.js replaceChangelog (lines 935-946) compares generated LF with raw existing text, and check-drift.js requires exact historical matches. This is line-ending drift, not section movement, path ordering or date handling. Pin CHANGELOG.md text eol=lf so Git preserves generator bytes; no CHANGELOG.md or node_modules edit. Upstream hardening would normalize CRLF to LF consistently before replace comparison, historical drift diagnosis and diff classification, with CRLF-only and real-content-change controls.
